extDescription.message: Lets your Clawdline agents use Chrome while you watch from your Mac or phone and take over at any time.

actionTitle.message: Clawdline: connection and what this extension does

statusReady.message: Connected to Clawdline on this computer

statusNoDaemon.message: Clawdline is not running on this computer

statusNoHost.message: Not connected yet. Finish the install guide in the Clawdline console.

what1.message: Your agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Grok) can open pages, read them, click and type, through Clawdline only.

what2.message: Their tabs open in a separate Clawdline window, so your own windows stay as they are.

what3.message: While a tab is in use, Chrome shows a bar saying it is being debugged. That bar is Chrome's own safeguard.

control1.message: Every action is recorded in Clawdline, with text typed into password fields left out.

control2.message: Take over any tab from the Clawdline console or your phone; the agent cannot see or act on it until you hand it back.

control3.message: Stop all browser use at once in Clawdline, Settings, Chrome.

privacy1.message: Only to the Clawdline app on this computer, through Chrome's native messaging. The extension itself connects to no server.

removeBody.message: Open chrome://extensions and choose Remove under Clawdline.
